[Act: limitation
 Chapter: Second Division · Appeals
 Section: 114::
]


Appeal from an order of acquittal,—
(a)under sub-section (1) or sub-section (2) of section 417 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (5 of 1898);
Period of limitationNinety days.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the order appealed from.
(b)under sub-section (3) of section 417 of that Code.
Period of limitationThirty days.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the grant of special leave.
